blocks.text: The module sets the Windows Proactor policy, loads optional environment variables, initializes optional Sentry, and imports the FastAPI, middleware, service, and router dependencies.
blocks.title: Platform and dependency setup

blocks.text: The imports and constants identify the route roster and explicitly size AnyIO's synchronous thread limiter from APP_THREAD_POOL_SIZE. Sentry configuration is enabled only when a DSN exists.
blocks.title: Application configuration

blocks.text: SIGINT signals in-flight retry waits, while _lifespan configures the running loop, warms the database, preloads Laya, connects configured MCP servers, and closes MCP clients after the application yields.
blocks.title: Lifecycle startup and shutdown

blocks.anchor: app = FastAPI(title="MiniMe v6 — EO layer API", lifespan=_lifespan)
blocks.text: The app installs CORS/error middleware and translates database saturation, agent-pool saturation, and task deadlines into 503 or 504 JSON responses.
blocks.title: Middleware and exception responses

blocks.anchor: # last piece of the B6 split) owns the deploy propose/write/go-live
blocks.text: The server includes the task, system, workspace, graph, notebook, device, usage, code-agent, MCP, and local-workspace routers, then installs code-agent handlers and wiring.
blocks.title: Router registration

blocks.anchor: async def websocket_endpoint(websocket: WebSocket, session_id: str, ticket: str = Query(None)):
blocks.text: websocket_endpoint requires a single-use ticket bound to the session, accepts and registers the socket, discards incoming text to detect disconnects, and unregisters it in finally.
blocks.title: Ticket-bound event socket

gotchas: Raw access tokens are rejected by the WebSocket endpoint
MCP connection failures are logged and do not block startup
how_it_works: Configures platform event-loop behavior and optional Sentry
Initializes thread, database, Laya, MCP, and signal state in lifespan
Maps capacity exceptions to 503 or 504 responses
Redeems a short-lived WebSocket ticket before registration
purpose: Importing this module configures the HTTP application and all route routers. Its lifespan warms shared services and its handlers turn capacity failures into actionable HTTP responses while the session socket receives pushed events.
summary: Creates the FastAPI application, installs infrastructure, manages startup and shutdown, and authenticates the event WebSocket.

symbols.summary: Signals in-flight LLM retry waits before delegating to uvicorn's normal SIGINT handler.

side_effects: sets thread limiter and event loop
symbols.summary: Initializes shared server services on startup and closes MCP connections on shutdown.
Returns a retryable 503 when database capacity is unavailable.
Returns a retryable 503 when the agent-task queue is full.
Returns a 504 while allowing the timed-out background task to continue.
Authenticates and maintains a session event WebSocket using a single-use stream ticket.

unknowns: Individual route behavior is implemented in the included routers.
